lines: KUSUM HARISH DHARAMSHI, role unknown, is due proceeds from selling 17,300,800 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹468.85 crore are scheduled on or about Wednesday, October 21, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are an estimate of ₹377.75 crore, and a family link exists to HARISH NARSHI DHARAMSHI.
Role is unknown and the listing date is unconfirmed, so verify both before the call.
